metadata.description: Small, fun and useful mods for Claude Code

plugins.name: terminal-pet
plugins.description: A cat in the empty prompt box that reacts to your day, with /pet-stats silly stats

plugins.name: usage-band
plugins.description: Session and weekly plan usage as gauges in a bar above the prompt

plugins.name: ringtones
plugins.description: Short synthesized chimes when a long turn finishes, a call is blocked, a turn fails or you ship

plugins.name: cross-fire
plugins.description: Holds destructive shell commands for your confirmation and says what they would hit

plugins.name: security-guard
plugins.description: Checks git commit and PR commands against the rules in your own and the project's CLAUDE.md files

plugins.name: session-resume
plugins.description: Sends "continue" when a rate-limit window resets after a limit stopped your turn

plugins.name: erp-log-nudge
plugins.description: Late-day weekday reminder to log ERP time when today is still empty

plugins.name: render-md
plugins.description: Renders the Markdown files Claude edits in a side pane, plus /render-md <file>
